name: Guangdong Yuehai Feeds Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Yuehai Feed Group Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of aquatic animal feeds, serving both Chinese and international markets. The company provides specialized compound feeds for prawns and fish, sold under its Yuehai and Haixuan labels. Founded in 1994, this enterprise is headquartered in Zhanjiang, China.
